summary: This is an 8-K filing by SLM Student Loan Trust 2005-5, a structured finance vehicle, reporting a failed remarketing of its class A-5 notes under the indenture and remarketing agreement. No committed purchasers were obtained for all tendered notes at the proposed spread, so all existing noteholders retain their notes; the interest rate will reset to SOFR plus 0.75% per annum for a three-month period ending July 27, 2026. This is a routine operational update for an asset-backed security trust, not reflective of a special-situation corporate transaction. No mergers, acquisitions, tender offers, or strategic events are involved. The filing does not trigger any special-situations category.
